knowledge.title: Opening hours
knowledge.content: Monday to Thursday 11:30 to 22:00, Friday and Saturday 11:30 to 23:00, Sunday 12:00 to 21:00. The kitchen takes last orders 30 minutes before closing.

knowledge.title: Wi-Fi
knowledge.content: The guest network is GingerCoal-Guest and the password is charcoal2026.

knowledge.title: Payment and tipping
knowledge.content: We accept all major cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay and cash. Bills can be split by item or evenly. Service is not included and tipping is optional. To pay, ask for the bill and a server brings the card machine to the table.

knowledge.title: Allergies and dish changes
knowledge.content: Our kitchen handles peanuts, tree nuts, sesame, soy, gluten, milk, eggs, fish, shellfish and molluscs. Allergen information on the menu is for each dish as written, and we do not remove allergens from a dish on request, so please choose a dish that is free from your allergen. The tofu for the Crispy Tofu Bao is fried in a shared fryer that is also used for shellfish, so it may contain traces of crustaceans. Guests with severe allergies should also speak to the manager on duty.

knowledge.title: Today's special
knowledge.content: Chef's pick today is the Miso-Glazed Salmon, made with salmon delivered this morning. On weekdays from 15:00 to 18:00 every Lemongrass Ginger Lemonade and Lychee Mint Spritz is 2 dollars off.

knowledge.title: Families, accessibility and parking
knowledge.content: High chairs are available and children are welcome; mild dishes that kids usually enjoy are the Mushroom Gyoza, the Korean BBQ Beef Bowl and the Mango Sticky Rice. The dining room and restroom are step-free. There is no private parking; the public garage on the next block offers two hours free with a validated receipt.
